## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
            2. _Ezra Cold_, Aug 19, 2026, 2/5: "this app will Always be RUNNING in the background no matter what you do to stop it. it will crash other programs and is an absolute menace to your phone. while useful when you want it, it's like a clingy rat that won't stop pestering you for attention."
            3. _Zander C_, Aug 19, 2026, 2/5: "I miss the old version of the app, now it's a buggy, cluttered mess. Sleep time recommendations are bizarre and annoying, I wish we could turn that off. Step tracking is less accurate too. 2 stars cuz it's convenient i guess"
